scope: Proposition 6.1 (Removal of a zero tail) of the manuscript “Tensor saturation for even spin groups” (preprints/Tensor-Saturation-for-Even-Spin-Groups-September-24-2026/Tensor-Saturation-for-Even-Spin-Groups-September-24-2026.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 204 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 aa18cc9fdf4734cc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 36. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Suppose λ, µ, ξ are dominant integral Dn-weights, all supported in coordinates 1, . . . , r, where 1 ≤ r ≤ n − 2. If V (ξ) occurs in V (λ) ⊗ V (µ), then V (2b ξ) occurs in V (2b λ) ⊗ V (2b µ) for Dr+1, where b λ = (L1, . . . , Lr, 0), and similarly for the other two labels.
